name: pop-vibe-check sentiment pipeline
description: Consumes replayed Reddit/YouTube/Steam records from Pub/Sub, detects language, classifies sentiment, and appends enriched rows to the BigQuery events_landing table. Unparseable records are routed to a dead-letter topic.

parameters.name: input_subscription
parameters.label: Input Pub/Sub subscription
parameters.helpText: Subscription to consume, as projects/<project>/subscriptions/<name>. Use the dataflow_input_subscription Terraform output.

parameters.name: output_table
parameters.label: BigQuery landing table
parameters.helpText: Write target as PROJECT:DATASET.TABLE. Always the landing table — the events table is written only by the promotion MERGE. Use the dataflow_events_landing_table Terraform output.

parameters.name: dlq_topic
parameters.label: Dead-letter topic
parameters.helpText: Topic for records that cannot be turned into an events row, as projects/<project>/topics/<name>. Use the dataflow_dlq_topic Terraform output.

parameters.name: nlp_model
parameters.label: NLP model name
parameters.helpText: Classifier to load from the nlp registry. Defaults to the deterministic stub.

parameters.name: bq_write_method
parameters.label: BigQuery write method
parameters.helpText: STREAMING_INSERTS (default, pure Python) or STORAGE_WRITE_API (cheaper per byte but requires a JRE in the image and a Java worker harness).

parameters.name: timestamp_attribute
parameters.label: Event-time attribute
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub attribute carrying event time. Defaults to created_utc; pass an empty string to fall back to publish time.

parameters.name: max_batch_size
parameters.label: Classifier batch size
parameters.helpText: Upper bound on records handed to the classifier at once. Defaults to 200.
